content.intended_use: Convert an online regret bound into a local gradient-average certificate.

proofs.full_local_argument: Projection nonexpansiveness gives sum_t <g_t,Delta_t-u> <= D^2/(2eta)+(eta/2)sum_t||g_t||^2 simultaneously for every u in B(0,D). Expectations give DG sqrt(T) per block. Distances between any two interpolation points in a block are <=DT, hence each is within DT=delta of their mean. Apply Theorem 8: (Delta+KDGsqrt(T))/(DKT)+sigma/sqrt(T)=Delta/(Kdelta)+(G+sigma)/sqrt(T). The displayed integer K,T make the two terms at most epsilon/2 each.

map: Use OGD regret against every comparator in the radius-D ball.

statement.conclusion: E m_delta(bar w) <= Delta/(K delta)+(G+sigma)/sqrt(T) <= Delta/(K delta)+2G/sqrt(T). For epsilon>0, K=max{1,ceil(2Delta/(delta epsilon))} and T=max{1,ceil(16G^2/epsilon^2)} suffice for E m_delta<=epsilon.
statement.objects_and_definitions: Same process, restarted Euclidean OGD on B(0,D) each T rounds, initialized at 0, eta=D/(G sqrt(T)), D=delta/T.
statement.quantifiers_and_randomness: Choose a uniform block after M=KT oracle calls.
